# Harvard Law Review

> A student-run legal scholarship journal publishing peer-reviewed articles on constitutional law, administrative law, tort law, and other core legal topics, alongside a fellowship program and writing competition.

Harvard Law Review is one of the nation's most influential law journals, featuring scholarly articles on constitutional law, first amendment issues, and other areas of legal practice. The publication also operates a fellowship program for recent law graduates and hosts a competitive writing competition for student editor selection.

## Key Topics

- Constitutional Law
- Legal Scholarship
- First Amendment
- Supreme Court
- Tort Law
- Administrative Law
- Criminal Justice
- Student Editors
- Harvard Law School
- Academic Articles
- Case Analysis
- Civil Procedure
- Public Interest Law
- U.S. Constitution
- Submission Guidelines

## Core Publications

- [Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org): Student-run legal scholarship journal homepage
- [Print - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/print): Print edition archive and access to Harvard Law Review articles
- [Harvard Law Review Forum](https://harvardlawreview.org/forum): Forum for scholarly discussion and reactions to published articles
- [Harvard Law Review Blog](https://harvardlawreview.org/blog): Blog with legal analysis and commentary on current issues

## Organization & Leadership

- [Organization & History - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/about): Organization history and structure of Harvard Law Review
- [Board of Editors - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/board-of-editors): Editorial board and staff listings for Harvard Law Review
- [State of the Review - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/state-of-the-review): Editorial updates and organizational governance announcements

## Fellowship & Competitions

- [The HLR Fellowship - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/fellowship): Fellowship program for recent law graduates
- [Apply - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/fellowship/apply): Fellowship application page with requirements and timeline
- [Writing Competition - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/writing-competition): Writing competition for student editor selection and membership

## Content Discovery & Research

- [Explore By Topic - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/explore-by-topic): Topic-based navigation for legal research and content discovery
- [Explore By Author - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/explore-by-author): Author directory for browsing Harvard Law Review contributors
- [Explore By Volume & Issue - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/explore-by-volume-issue): Archive directory organized by volume and issue numbers

## Legal Topics & Scholarship

- [Constitutional Law - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/topics/constitutional-law): Topic page for constitutional law articles and analysis
- [First Amendment - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/topics/first-amendment): Topic page for First Amendment and free speech scholarship
- [Torts - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/topics/torts): Topic page for tort law articles and scholarship

## Author Resources & Submissions

- [Submissions - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/homepage/submissions): Article submission guidelines and requirements for authors

## Featured Articles & Symposia

- [Judicial Review in Jeopardy? Symposium](https://harvardlawreview.org/judicial-review-in-jeopardy-a-symposium): Symposium on judicial review and structural constitutional law
- [What is a Tort? - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/print/vol-139/what-is-a-tort): Article on tort law definition and negligence doctrine
- [Blown Chances - Harvard Law Review](https://harvardlawreview.org/print/vol-139/blown-chances): Book review on school desegregation and civil rights law
